Description: Registers a new user as either an Organiser or a Participant.
Expected Response:
201 Created - User creation successful with user details (excluding password).
400 Bad Request - Validation errors.
409 Conflict - Email already exists.

Description: Authenticates a user and returns a JWT access token.
Expected Response:
200 OK - Login successful, returns JWT token and user role.
401 Unauthorized - Invalid credentials.
400 Bad Request - Missing/invalid fields.

Description: Retrieves the profile of the currently authenticated user.
Expected Response:
200 OK - Returns user details including role and profile data.
401 Unauthorized - No token or invalid token.

Description: Updates the profile of the currently authenticated user.
Expected Response:
200 OK - Updated user and profile object.
400 Bad Request - Validation errors.
404 Not Found - User not found.

Description: Retrieves a list of all events (supports filters, sorting, pagination).
Retrieves detailed information for a single event.
Expected Response:
200 OK - Detailed event object.
404 Not Found - Event ID does not exist.

201 Created - New event object.
400 Bad Request - Validation errors.
403 Forbidden - Not an Organiser.

200 OK - Updated event object.
400 Bad Request - Validation errors.
403 Forbidden - Not event owner.
404 Not Found - Event ID not found.

Description: Deletes an event and all associated data.
Expected Response:
204 No Content - Deletion successful.
403 Forbidden - Not event owner.
404 Not Found - Event ID not found.

Description: Retrieves all categories for an event.
Expected Response:
200 OK - List of categories.
404 Not Found - Event ID not found.

Description: Creates a new category for an event.
Expected Response:
201 Created - New category object.
400 Bad Request - Validation errors.
403 Forbidden - Not event owner.
404 Not Found - Event not found.

200 OK - Updated category.
403 Forbidden - Not event owner.
404 Not Found - Category not found.

204 No Content - Deletion successful.
403 Forbidden - Not event owner.
404 Not Found - Category not found.

Description: Retrieves all enrolments for the authenticated participant.
Expected Response:
200 OK - List of enrolments.
401 Unauthorized - Not a Participant.

Description: Creates a new enrolment for a category.
Expected Response:
201 Created - New enrolment object.
400 Bad Request - Validation errors.
404 Not Found - Category not found.

200 OK - Updated enrolment.
403 Forbidden - Not enrolment owner.
404 Not Found - Enrolment not found.

Description: Allows Organiser to capture/update participant’s result.
Expected Response:
200 OK - Updated enrolment with result.
403 Forbidden - Not event organiser.
404 Not Found - Enrolment not found.

Description: Retrieves all enrolments with results for an event.
Expected Response:
200 OK - List of enrolments with results.
404 Not Found - Event not found.
